command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

tar -xf rad.tar

echo "== A: --min-reads 1 -- every planted cell must survive =="
alevin-fry generate-permit-list -d fw -i rad -o qdA --unfiltered-pl barcodes.txt --min-reads 1 > gpA.log 2>&1
alevin-fry collate -i qdA -r rad -t 2 > colA.log 2>&1
alevin-fry quant -i qdA -o resA -m t2g.tsv -r cr-like -t 2 > qA.log 2>&1

echo "== B: DEFAULT --min-reads -- demonstrates the silent low-count-cell drop =="
alevin-fry generate-permit-list -d fw -i rad -o qdB --unfiltered-pl barcodes.txt > gpB.log 2>&1
alevin-fry collate -i qdB -r rad -t 2 > colB.log 2>&1
alevin-fry quant -i qdB -o resB -m t2g.tsv -r cr-like -t 2 > qB.log 2>&1

# rebuild the (barcode, gene, count) triples from the MatrixMarket output
mk() { awk 'NR==FNR{r[FNR]=$1; next} FNR==1{next} FNR==2{next} FNR==3{next} {print r[$1]"\tg"$2"\t"$3}' \
        "$1/alevin/quants_mat_rows.txt" "$1/alevin/quants_mat.mtx" | sort; }
mk resA > gotA.tsv; mk resB > gotB.tsv
echo "--- A (min-reads 1) ---"; cat gotA.tsv
echo "--- B (default) ---";     cat gotB.tsv

CELLS_A=$(wc -l < resA/alevin/quants_mat_rows.txt | tr -d ' ')
CELLS_B=$(wc -l < resB/alevin/quants_mat_rows.txt | tr -d ' ')
SUM_A=$(awk '{s+=$3} END{print s+0}' gotA.tsv)
READS=$(awk '/reads/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="reads") print $(i+1)}' fixture.txt)
EXACT_A=no; cmp -s truth.tsv gotA.tsv && EXACT_A=yes
DROPPED=$(comm -23 <(cut -f1 truth.tsv | sort -u) <(cut -f1 gotB.tsv | sort -u) | tr '\n' ' ')

{
  echo "Single-cell quantification -- piscem + alevin-fry against a planted count matrix"
  echo "piscem                0.23.0 (map-sc)   alevin-fry 0.9.0"
  echo "reads                 $READS   (every read carries a UNIQUE UMI, so counts == reads)"
  echo "cells_min_reads_1     $CELLS_A   (assert 3 -- all planted cells retained)"
  echo "matrix_exact          $EXACT_A   (assert yes -- EXACT: every (cell,gene,count) triple equals the planted value)"
  echo "count_sum             $SUM_A of $READS   (assert equal -- CONSERVATION: one unique UMI becomes exactly one count)"
  echo "cells_default_minreads $CELLS_B   (assert 2 -- see below)"
  echo "dropped_by_default    $DROPPED  (the 8-read cell: alevin-fry's --unfiltered-pl defaults to --min-reads 10 and drops it SILENTLY)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$CELLS_A" -eq 3
test "$EXACT_A" = yes
test "$SUM_A" -eq "$READS"
test "$CELLS_B" -eq 2
test -n "$DROPPED"
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
